description: This file defines a utility for voice wake forwarding, including functions for creating transcripts, handling errors, and managing communication with a gateway connection.

methods.name: prefixedTranscript
methods.description: Generates a prefixed transcript message including machine name info for voice recognition.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Sends the voice transcript to the gateway connection with specified options and returns the result asynchronously.

methods.name: checkConnection
methods.description: Checks the status of the gateway connection asynchronously.
